test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Why would Celia burn the letter?

options.text: Why is the letter burned by Celia?
Why would the letter be burned by Celia?
Why Celia would burn the letter?
Why the letter burned by Celia?

solution:
The correct answer is '**Why would the letter be burned by Celia?**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the **Active Voice**.
 
• As per the question, we have to change it into the **Passive Voice**.
 
 
• The structure of the **passive voice** is:
 
 
• **Object of the active sentence + the appropriate form of the verb "to be" + past participle of the main verb + by + subject of the active sentence (optional)**
 
 
 
• Using this structure, the correct **passive form** of the given sentence would be:
 
 
• **Why would the letter be burned by Celia?**
 
 
 
 

Thus, ***option 2*** is the correct answer.
